verdict.rationale: Kitty ships a documented kittens system extensible in Python, plus remote-control scripting APIs (verified hands-on in kitty-probe-rt-1) and config/mapping extensibility, directly matching the story of extending the terminal with real-language scripts/plugins beyond built-ins. Missing for 10: independent third-party evidence of custom kitten development (community citations focus on performance/UX rather than plugin authoring).
